items.title: Nuclear aur particle physics: ta'aruf (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to nuclear physics (PDF 137-138).

blocks.text: Ernest Rutherford ke 1911 ke tajurbat ne dikhaya ke atom ka aik ghana, musbat charge wala bohat chhota markazi hissa, nucleus, hai jo electrons se ghira hai. 1920 mein Rutherford ne tajweez kiya ke musbat charge nucleus mein protons ki wajah se hai aur aik be-charge zarre ki peshgoi ki; yeh peshgoi tab sach hui jab James Chadwick ne 1932 mein neutron daryaft kiya.

Nuclear physics atomic nuclei aur zer-e-atomic zarrat ka mutala hai. Yeh chapter shuaein chhorne wale ghair-mustahkam nuclei, un ke toot'ne (decay), aur fission aur fusion jaise nuclear reactions par baat karta hai, jo bohat zyada tawanai chhor kar insaniyat ko faida dete hain. Radioactive isotopes tibbi tashkhees aur ilaj, zaraat, tehqeeq aur sanat mein tracers ke taur par use hote hain.

Nucleus, jise aksar nuclide kehte hain, symbol X ke saath mass number A aur atomic (charge) number Z likh kar dikhaya jata hai, jahan X kimiyai symbol, Z protons ki tadaad aur A nucleons (protons aur neutrons) ki kul tadaad hai. Neutrons ki tadaad N = A - Z. Yun hydrogen, carbon aur uranium 1-1-H, 12-6-C aur 235-92-U likhe jate hain. Nucleus bohat ghana hai, us ka radius 10^-14 m ke darje ka, electrons ke badal se ghira; atom ka radius 10^-10 m ke darje ka hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Alpha zarrat ke bikharne ke tajurbat se Lord Rutherford ne nateeja nikala ke atom ka zyada tar hissa khali hai aur us ki kamiyat nucleus naam ke bohat chhote hisse mein mutamarkiz hai.

blocks.prompt: Uranium-235 (Z = 92) nucleus mein kitne protons aur neutrons hain?

items: Nuclide ka andaz: A = nucleons, Z = protons, N = A - Z.
Nucleus ka radius taqreeban 10^-14 m; atom ka taqreeban 10^-10 m.
